title: Moveleft
description: x-moveleft is a button inside an x-move container: a click swaps the item holding it with the previous item and fires wb:reorder on the container. x-move wires it; it reads no attributes.

wb:reorder.description: Fired on the container after a swap.

_metadata.derivedFrom: move.js moveleft() — every property here is one the behavior reads
